ratios.label: Revenue growth
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: H1 2026 and FY2025 are not the same kind of period, so a percentage change between them would compare part of a year with a whole one

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E a PEG divides is itself withheld, so there is no P/E to divide by the growth rate. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the market capitalisation behind every multiple of this security carries no price date, so the price each multiple divides is not a dated figure and the multiple cannot be audited. valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (nampaklimited) is served under two keys, NPK.JO and NPK, whose market multiples disagree (PE 3.44 vs None; PB 1.42 vs 2.8; PS 0.37 vs 0.4); one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
